table.name: Developer Immobilizer
table.description: Exact JK08A only. Bit 0 enables ECM immobilizer enforcement. Vehicle start and operation verified. NATS DTC suppression is independent.

table.name: Rolling Launch Require Accelerator Pedal
table.description: Exact JK08A. Enabled writes min_pedal=1 and requires a nonzero normalized accelerator-pedal signal for activation. Disabled writes min_pedal=0, which makes the pedal gate unconditional. The signal is not presented as a calibrated pedal percentage.
